definitions.explanation: A young human being, or one's own offspring regardless of age.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}が3{人|にん}います。
{子供|こども}たちは{公園|こうえん}で{遊|あそ}んでいます。
examples.english: The children are playing in the park.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{時|とき}、よく{泳|およ}ぎました。
examples.english: When I was a child, I swam often.
examples.notes: 子供の時 = when (I was) a child

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}にも{分|わ}かるように{説明|せつめい}してください。
examples.english: Please explain it in a way that even a child can understand.

examples.japanese: あの{夫婦|ふうふ}には{子供|こども}が{五人|ごにん}いて、{毎日|まいにち}{大変|たいへん}そうです。
examples.english: That couple has five children and seems to have a hard time every day.

notes:
Can refer to children in general or one's own children. お{子|こ}さん is the polite form for 'your child/children'.

Related:
- {子|こ} (child - shorter form)
- {男|おとこ}の{子|こ} (boy)
- {女|おんな}の{子|こ} (girl).
